segments.name: OBESITY DRUGS
segments.note: Lilly Q3 revenue $24.4B (+39%); 2026 guide raised to $91–92B. Novo guided 2026 sales down up to 13% and is losing share. Viking has no revenue yet.

segments.name: AI POWER + COOLING
segments.note: Wood Mackenzie: US data-center electrical equipment about $20B to about $65B by 2030 (27%/yr is our arithmetic on a 2025 base). GE Vernova Q3 orders +96%, gas power backlog 122 GW. Vertiv leads cooling.

segments.name: CUSTOM AI CHIPS
segments.note: TrendForce: custom AI chip shipments +44.6% in 2026 vs +16.1% for GPUs (units, not revenue). Broadcom and Marvell hold about 95% of custom-chip design.

segments.name: WAREHOUSE + HUMANOID ROBOTS
segments.note: Symbotic trailing revenue $2.65B (+21%); market share unverified. Tesla Optimus entered early production at Fremont, outside deliveries targeted around end-2027, no revenue yet. ABI forecasts humanoids at $6.5B by 2030.

segments.name: SPACE: PHONE SATELLITES + SUPPLIERS
segments.note: Omdia: direct-to-phone satellite revenue to about $12B by 2030. SpaceX leads (over $50 a share, shown for reference); AST SpaceMobile Q3 revenue $42.3M (+187%), $3.2B cash, 45 satellites now targeted mid-2027.
